title: PASSIVE VOICE PRACTICE & TIPS
description: Learn to use passive voice correctly in different tenses.

questions.question: Convert to passive voice: 'The chef cooks the meal.'
options: The meal is cooked by the chef.
The meal was cooked by the chef.
The meal has been cooked by the chef.
The meal will be cooked by the chef.
questions.explanation: Present simple passive: am/is/are + past participle. 'The meal is cooked by the chef.'

questions.question: Choose the correct passive form: 'The house _____ last year.'
questions.explanation: Past simple passive: was/were + past participle. 'Last year' indicates past time.

questions.question: Complete the passive: 'The project _____ by the team next month.'
questions.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + past participle. 'Next month' indicates future time.

questions.question: Convert to passive: 'They are building a new bridge.'
options: A new bridge is being built.
A new bridge was being built.
A new bridge has been built.
A new bridge will be built.
questions.explanation: Present continuous passive: am/is/are being + past participle.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'The letter _____ yesterday.'
questions.explanation: Past simple passive: was/were + past participle. 'Yesterday' indicates past time.

questions.question: Complete: 'The work _____ by tomorrow.'
questions.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + past participle. 'By tomorrow' indicates future completion.

questions.question: Convert to passive: 'Someone has stolen my car.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect passive: has/have been + past participle.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'The book _____ in many languages.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect passive for actions completed in the past with present relevance.

questions.question: Complete: 'The meeting _____ at 3 PM.'
questions.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + past participle for scheduled future events.

title: Academic Writing: Passive Voice
description: Advanced passive voice practice for academic writing contexts.

questions.question: Convert to academic passive: 'Researchers conducted the study.'
options: The study was conducted by researchers.
The study is conducted by researchers.
The study has been conducted by researchers.
The study will be conducted by researchers.
questions.explanation: Academic writing often uses passive voice to focus on the research rather than the researchers.

questions.question: Choose the correct academic form: 'The results _____ in the next section.'
questions.explanation: Future passive is common in academic writing to indicate what will be covered next.
